  3. <fidel-table>

<fidel-table>

Tables that fit a phone. Wraps a real <table>: adds header scopes, becomes "Header: value" cards when narrow, and can sort.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Low-vision learners at 400 % zoom and phone users (no sideways scrolling); screen readers still get a real table.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት።

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-table sortable="true">
  <table>
    <caption>Lessons this week</caption>
    <thead><tr><th>Lesson</th><th>Length</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody><tr><th>HTML basics</th><td>12:30</td></tr></tbody>
  </table>
</fidel-table>

Source: player/src/components/e/table.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-table>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
sortabletrueoffEach column header becomes a sort button.
show-warningsbooleanoffA visible note for authors when the <caption> is missing.
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-table>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-table-sort{ column, direction }The table was sorted.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • Sort buttons in the column headers; aria-sort says the order and "Sorted by Length, ascending." is announced.
  • Sort buttons stay reachable in the card layout.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Its own buttons and messages are in English or Amharic. Set ui-lang="am" on the tag (or on a parent); without it, the page's lang is used, else English.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 1.3.1 Info and Relationships: Keeps the <table>, adds <th scope> and explicit table roles. A missing <caption> is warned about, not fixed.
  • 1.4.10 Reflow: Narrow tables become cards (CSS container query) instead of scrolling sideways.
  • 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value: aria-sort on the sorted column.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
